name: Medan Independent School
address: Jl. Jamin Ginting Km 10 / Jl. Tali Air No.5, Mangga, Medan Tuntungan, Kota Medan

notes.id: Tuition tahunan K1–K2 Rp56.606.000; K3 Rp108.723.000. Biaya pendaftaran Rp45.000.000 sekali untuk siswa baru (K3 ke atas). Capital fee Rp25.000.000 per tahun (wajib). Kurs dihitung Rp18.000/USD dan disesuaikan tiap term. Diskon sibling 5%.
notes.en: Annual tuition K1–K2 Rp56,606,000; K3 Rp108,723,000. One-time registration fee Rp45,000,000 for new students (K3 and above). Capital fee Rp25,000,000 per year (mandatory). Rate based on IDR 18,000/USD, adjusted each term. 5% sibling discount.
